name: Heroku
symbol: Automated Certificate Management retry timing for failing certificates
title: Heroku: Automated Certificate Management retry timing for failing certificates (behavior change)
summary: Starting November 11, 2026, Automated Certificate Management (ACM) changes how it retries certificate renewals for custom domains
replacement: Run heroku certs:auto:refresh to retry sooner than the 6-hour wait

name: Heroku
symbol: Automated Certificate Management certificate renewal timing
title: Heroku: Automated Certificate Management certificate renewal timing (behavior change)
summary: Starting November 16, 2026, Automated Certificate Management (ACM) checks with Let’s Encrypt when to renew each certificate

name: Heroku
symbol: ACM certificate key type from RSA to ECDSA P-256
title: Heroku: ACM certificate key type from RSA to ECDSA P-256 (new default)
summary: Starting December 21, 2026, Automated Certificate Management (ACM) will issue certificates with an Elliptic Curve Digital Signature Algorithm (ECDSA) P-256 key instead of a Rivest-Shamir-Adleman (RSA) key
replacement: Enable the acm-rsa-cert feature to keep RSA certificates for the app before December 21, 2026, or use acm-ec-cert on Cedar-generation Private Spaces.

name: Heroku
title: Heroku heroku-22: end of life 2027-04-30
summary: The Heroku-22 stack is deprecated and will reach end-of-life on April 30th, 2027. Upgrade to a newer stack as soon as possible
replacement: Upgrade to a newer stack as soon as possible.
